_what: Settings for the classifier-guided generation and its matched unguided control.
_prerequisites: This stage runs only if the panel classifier reaches usable validation performance, its region-masking diagnostics show a panel effect above the control regions, and the gradient probe returns a finite, non-zero gradient that fits in memory.

settings.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, warped geometry, duplicated objects, flicker, text, watermark
settings._matched: The guided run and the unguided control share every setting here and the same generator seed, so both start from identical initial noise. The only difference is the classifier term.
